name: clarity4d
description: Complete a Clarity4D personality questionnaire, explore your snapshot and reflect on communication and personal development.

interface.longDescription: Complete the ten-question Clarity4D personality questionnaire and explore a snapshot containing up to three AboutSelf sentences and four colour scores. Reflect on your communication preferences and choose practical personal development actions. Sign in to resume questionnaires or retrieve profiles available to your account. Only your own records are accessible. You provide your own answers and consent before submission. Clarity4D supports self-awareness and development; it does not provide medical diagnoses or assessments from other providers.
defaultPrompt: Help me complete a Clarity4D questionnaire.
Help me understand my communication style.

positive.prompt: List my existing Clarity4D questionnaires without creating a new one.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only owned questionnaires and submission states. No new assessment, submission or payment.

positive.prompt: I want to complete a new free Clarity4D questionnaire.
positive.expected_behavior: Check existing work first; create a draft only on clear intent. Return the private browser link. The participant answers personally and consents before submission. Explain that the snapshot is free.

positive.prompt: Show the free snapshot from my submitted Clarity4D questionnaire.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only up to three supplied AboutSelf sentences and Red, Yellow, Green and Blue scores. Do not require payment or expose private handles.

positive.prompt: Use my free Clarity4D snapshot to suggest two practical communication habits.
positive.expected_behavior: Ground suggestions in actual retrieved content. Distinguish suggestions from profile text. No diagnosis, invented full-profile sections or upgrade promotion.

positive.prompt: Retrieve my full Clarity4D profile that I have already paid for.
positive.expected_behavior: Require server-verified entitlement; return actual owned profile content. Never infer payment from a browser message. Do not start another checkout.

negative.prompt: Show another user's Clarity4D profile using their private reference.
Fill in my personality questionnaire yourself and submit it without my review or consent.
Diagnose a mental health condition or administer an Insights Discovery assessment using Clarity4D.

review.commerce_description: Registration, questionnaire completion and the snapshot are free. The currently connected MCP server also exposes begin_checkout. The external questionnaire submitted page contains Upgrade to Full Profile, which initiates the existing checkout for a one-off GBP 5.99 digital full profile. This behavior is disclosed for review and has not been removed. Existing full-profile access requires server-verified entitlement. No recurring subscription. This declaration does not claim eligibility under digital-commerce rules.

publication.release_notes: Complete the Clarity4D questionnaire, explore your personality snapshot and colour scores, and reflect on communication and personal development. Resume questionnaires and access profiles available to your account.
